title: なおとっち CARD GAME
entry: prototypes/card-game/index.html (allowlist entrypoint); linked from main menu index.html:492. Script: app.mjs (module).
audio: none. No AudioContext / Audio / speechSynthesis / audio.js / vibrate in prototypes/card-game/*.mjs or index.html.

rules_relevant_to_pacing.length: 10 rounds; start そだち20; highest そだち after round 10 wins; draw on tie (rulebook-content.mjs chapter 2 'ゲームの目的・勝利条件').
rules_relevant_to_pacing.early_victory: R1-R9: reaching そだち100 and holding it through the end of the opponent's next turn = 早期勝利. R10 has no early victory (rulebook-content.mjs).
rules_relevant_to_pacing.round_display: turn indicator shows 'ROUND n/10' (ui-presentation.mjs turn indicator).
rules_relevant_to_pacing.late_game_note: There is no distinct 'late phase' screen. Candidates for a late/finisher cue (inference): ROUND 9-10, or a player at そだち100 holding for early victory. late-conditions.mjs is card-condition logic, not a screen.
